reason.zh: 本厂主轴 Z 行程对应最大雕深 12 mm，来料 {carve_depth_mm} mm 超限。
reason.en: The spindle travel allows 12 mm of carve depth; the submitted {carve_depth_mm} mm exceeds it.

text.zh: 把雕深降到 10 mm 以内，或改用拼雕分层做法。
text.en: Reduce carve depth below 10 mm, or carve in laminated layers.

reason.en: Kiln and clamps support a 1200 mm span; {span_mm} mm needs segmentation.

text.zh: 分为两段并在现场拼装，或改用纵向支撑。
text.en: Split into two sections for site assembly, or add longitudinal support.

reason.en: Secondary drying reaches 14%; {wood_moisture_pct}% cannot stabilise within the lead time.

text.zh: 改用含水率 12% 以下的坯料，延长干燥期。
text.en: Supply blanks at or below 12% moisture and extend the drying window.
